newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TAKES PROVISIONAL POLE AT SUZUKA.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TAKES PROVISIONAL POLE AT SUZUKA.

text.p: Reigning 500cc world champion Michael Doohan comfortably took provisional pole for Sunday's Japanese motorcycling Grand Prix when he was almost two seconds faster than the rest of the field in Friday's opening qualifying session.
Riding in drizzling rain, Doohan, on a Honda, had a fastest lap of two minutes 12.908 seconds round the 5.864 km (3.644 miles) Suzuka circuit.
Japanese rider Norihiko Fujiwara on a Yamaha clocked two minutes 14.746 seconds to be second fastest. Last year's winner at Suzuka, Japan's Norifumi Abe, could manage no better than 18th.
The rain, which started to worsen in the afternoon, forced riders to change tyres in the middle of the session.
The final qualifying session is on Saturday.
World 250cc champion Max Biaggi of Italy dislocated his left shoulder when he crashed his Honda during qualifying.
Organisers said it was unclear if he would take part in Saturday's second qualifying session.
